Survey design validation protocol

Source: vignettes/articles/design-validation.Rmd
design-validation.Rmd

This protocol compares the placeholder-row design returned by nis_design() with a survey design built from the full invented data, before domain subsetting. Fixtures come from nis_example() and contain no licensed records.

Cases

  • Complete pooled years (2017–2019), with cohort and non-cohort discharges across hospitals and years.
  • Complete 2015 and 2016 data with a cohort limited to Q4 2015, which tests detection of the ICD-10-coded era.
  • Invalid design rows in the input; the reference removes the same rows failing positive, finite YEAR, HOSP_NIS, NIS_STRATUM, or DISCWT checks.
  • Annualized weights, divided by the count of valid-design years, including the partial year as one year.
  • A rare cohort represented in only one quarter of a full data year is silent; pre-filtering the data to Q1-Q3 warns because valid-design data then has only three quarters.
  • A Q4-only cohort in 2015 warns that it covers the ICD-10-coded part of the year, while a complete cohort year is silent. Without DQTR, the 2015 split cannot be checked and an informational message says so.

Quarter coverage is computed by grouping valid-design rows in the lazy query by YEAR and DQTR, then collecting that small summary. Cohort-quarter checks use only true cohort discharges, so zero-domain placeholder rows do not affect the result.

Compared statistics

At absolute tolerance 1e-8, compare survey means and standard errors, weighted totals and standard errors, svyratio() estimates and variance, confint() for means, svyby() estimates and standard errors, logistic and Gaussian svyglm() coefficients and covariance matrices, and median svyquantile() estimates. Compare design degrees of freedom exactly and the gtsummary p-values at 1e-8. Annualized totals are compared with full-data reference totals divided by the number of valid-design years.

Reference construction

Start from collected nis_example() data and compute .in_cohort for every row. Build year-qualified PSU and stratum identifiers and use original or annualized DISCWT values in srvyr::as_survey_design(..., nest = TRUE). Apply dplyr::filter(.in_cohort) only after constructing that full-data design. For invalid-row cases, filter out exactly the rows that nis_design() excludes before building the reference. This preserves non-cohort observations in each hospital-year so domain estimates have the same sampling structure.
